headline.zh: 营业至凌晨2点的咖啡酒吧
headline.en: Open until 2am as a coffee bar

traits.zh: 临街开放式窗口，设室外座位
traits.en: Street-facing open window with outdoor seating

traits.zh: 室内光线明亮，靠窗户采光
traits.en: Bright interior lit by natural light from windows

traits.zh: 推荐饮品含巧克力与咖啡
traits.en: Recommended drinks include chocolate and coffee

traits.zh: 店面临街，室外区域铺红砖
traits.en: Street-facing facade with red-brick outdoor area

focus.zh: 营业至凌晨但周末晚始营业
focus.en: Late hours but weekend starts at 5pm

linger.zh: 有室外座位与明亮空间宜久坐
linger.en: Outdoor seating and bright space support lingering

adventure.zh: 饮品配肉桂棒与迷迭香
adventure.en: Drinks garnished with cinnamon stick and rosemary
